import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Test database connectivity from the app container
print('=== Testing Database Connection ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('pm2 logs areloria --lines 20 --nostream')
logs = stdout.read().decode()
print(logs[-3000:] if len(logs) > 3000 else logs)
# Test Kong API is accessible
print('\\n=== Testing Kong (API Gateway) ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('curl -s https://localhost:8443/auth/v1/ -I')
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Test auth service directly
print('\\n=== Testing Auth Service ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('docker exec supabase-auth curl -s http://localhost:9998/health')
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
